product_metadata.title: iDesign Rust-Resistant Stainless Steel Sponge Holder for Kitchen Sink with Suction Cups, The Gia Collection - Set of 1, Pearl White
features: KITCHEN SPONGE HOLDER –The iDesign Gia Collection Stainless Steel Dish Sponge Holder and kitchen sink caddy keeps cleaning supplies such as bar soap, sponges, scrub brushes, and more off the countertop and within reach

OPEN DESIGN WITH SUCTION CUP ADHESION – This kitchen sink organizer features an open wire design that allows items to dry more efficiently after use, while the included suction cups maintain a secure hold in wet or dry conditions

EASY INSTALLATION – To install the kitchen sponge holder for sinks, push the suction cups into place for a powerful hold on most smooth surfaces including glass, tile, fiberglass & some metals; clean the surface with alcohol & let dry before applying

MADE WITH RUST-RESISTANT STAINLESS STEEL – Featuring durable rust-resistant stainless steel construction with a pearl white finish, the iDesign sink sponge caddy stands up to everyday use and is easy to clean with mild soap and water; hand wash only
EFFICIENT STYLE – Measures 5.75" x 2.5" x 2.25" and creates instant kitchen sink organization in compact spaces; plus, the sleek satin finish will complement any décor style
description: Add a touch of organizational style to your kitchen sink with the iDesign Gia Collection Sink Sponge Holder with Suction Cups. This sponge caddy for kitchen sinks keeps cleaning supplies off the countertop and within reach. The open wire design of the in sink sponge holder provides proper airflow and allows items to dry more efficiently after use, while the included suction cups maintain a secure hold in wet or dry conditions. Measuring 5.75" x 2.5" x 2.25", this sink sponge holder creates instant and easy storage.

Featuring a modern design with a pearl white finish, this versatile kitchen caddy matches a variety of decor styles and can also be used in the bathroom, laundry room, or anywhere you need organization. It’s an essential kitchen sink sponge holder that features rust-resistant stainless steel construction that stands up to everyday use and is easy to clean with mild soap and water. With iDesign, you can live simply and sustainably every day.
